# sccfm-cli inventory devices asa shun show

```text
$ sccfm-cli inventory devices asa shun show --help

Usage: sccfm-cli inventory devices asa shun show [OPTIONS]

  Display active shun entries on ASA devices. Use --statistics for per-interface
  counters.

Options:
  -n, --device-name TEXT      Device name to search for (supports wildcards like
                              'branch-*').
  -q, --query TEXT            Filter devices by a Lucene query.
  -l, --limit INTEGER RANGE   Maximum records to return  [default: 50;
                              1<=x<=200]
  -o, --offset INTEGER RANGE  Pagination offset  [default: 0; x>=0]
  -u, --device-uids TEXT      List of device UIDs to view shuns on.
  --statistics                Show per-interface shun statistics instead of shun
                              entries.
  --format [table|json]       Output format  [default: table]
  --config-path PATH          Path to the configuration file (defaults to
                              ~/.sccfm-cli/config.json).
  --help                      Show this message and exit.
```
